notes: Batch i: 30 recipes. Candidates 1-30 below are what batch-i.json records. 2 came from candidates-2 (kikkoman-ebichahan, sirogohan-yakionigiri); the other 28 are new, found on the Kikkoman Home Cooking bento pages (meat / seafood / shouwa / enji lists) and on sirogohan.com, each page fetched on 2026-11-12 with the page title checked.

Most Delish Kitchen recipe pages are now behind the Premium wall (ingredients and steps hidden), so the unused candidates-2 reserves from that host could not be used; reasons are in skippedFromCandidates2.

Kikkoman set pages show bentos of 2-4 components that are 2-serving (or 4-serving) recipes; batch i records the main dish plus one or two sides, all in the same unit, with the source amounts unchanged (yield 2人分).
estMinutes is the sum of the component times shown on the source pages.
